value: Kestrelway Field Services runs five assets: KW-0002, KW-0008, KW-0012, KW-0027 and KW-0041.
Reefer 41 has been parked at the Quellby depot since 2026-10-19 waiting for a compressor repair.
Reefer 41's device reported under-voltage before it went offline; the depot disconnected its battery for the repair.
Shop Pickup 2 is the workshop's test vehicle; its device samples at 1 Hz.
Linehaul Tractor 27 runs the overnight trunk route between the Brindleford yard and the Carrowmoor cross-dock.
City Hauler 12 does multi-drop deliveries in the Brindleford centre, usually 12 to 16 stops a day.
Route Van 8 covers the residential loops around Ostley Cross and rarely drives more than 40 km a day.
Route Van 8's SIM receives carrier notices; the fleet lead clears its inbox monthly after approval.
Command approvals are decided by the fleet lead on duty.
The fleet desk is staffed 07:00 to 19:00, Monday to Saturday.
Overspeed events with a pending review are held out of the driver score until the fleet lead keeps or drops them.
Driver events are delivered to the fleet backend's webhook receiver, which checks each delivery's signature with the shared signing secret.
The webhook signing secret was rotated on 2026-10-21 at 08:12 UTC as part of the quarterly key rotation.
Linehaul Tractor 27 still runs agent 0.9.2; the update to 0.9.4 is scheduled for its next yard visit.
City Hauler 12's antenna sits under a steel roof panel, so its GPS fix is often weak between tall buildings.
Kestrelway's OBD tiers: full (speed, rpm, pedal, coolant, fuel, codes), basic (speed and rpm), none (GPS only).
Route Van 8's rules were resynced on 2026-10-23 at 08:40 UTC after a template update, so they show pending.
The workshop asked to keep harsh braking and acceleration rules off on any device that samples below 5 Hz.
